releaseNotes:
<!--LANG:en-->
Dusk — first build of the Dusk fork as a standalone Work OS.

- Standalone: no account, no telemetry, no Dusk cloud services
- Bring your own provider: OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama
- Full chat, agents, knowledge base, and MCP support

<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
Dusk —— Dusk 分叉后的首个独立工作台版本。

- 完全独立：无账号、无遥测、无 Dusk 云服务
- 自带服务商：OpenAI 兼容端点、Anthropic、Gemini、Ollama
- 完整的对话、智能体、知识库与 MCP 支持

<!--LANG:END-->
